content.text: I'll onboard you to Squire Docs. Your browser will open Squire Docs' connect page. Sign in with Google — if you've never used Squire Docs, that same click creates your account; there is no separate signup step. Then approve the connection so I can create and sync docs for you.

This session is remote, so the localhost callback may show a connection error — that is expected, the approval still succeeded. Open this authorization URL:

http://localhost:3001/mcp/auth/authorize?client_id=abc&response_type=code&code_challenge=xyz

Then copy the FULL URL from your browser address bar and paste it back to me.

Now that the skill is installed, I will read the spec from the doc before each run and write status and design back after implementing — and your teammates and other agents will see those attributed edits in the same doc. That is the standing loop.
Once the tools appear I would find your spec and sync it, delivering the doc URL.
